hero.title: Build plans for your home board
hero.subtitle: DXF files a CNC shop cuts straight from. Every panel, the T-nut grid, the LED holes and the kicker, laid out on the sheets your shop already stocks.
hero.firstBoard: Kilter Homewall is the first supported board. More boards follow.

included.heading: What you get
included.dxf: One DXF per panel, plus assembly drawings for the whole wall.
included.pdf: Printable A3 or Tabloid sheets, so you can check the layout before anyone cuts.
included.bom: A cut list: sheet count, panel sizes, and every hole counted.
included.licence: A licence with your name on it, good for one wall.

hero.trademarkNote: Boardsesh is not affiliated with Aurora Climbing, Kilter or any board maker. These are plans for building a wall that works with holds and LEDs you buy yourself.

tiers.heading: Pick a licence
tiers.intro: One licence, one wall. A second wall needs a second licence.

personal.name: Personal
personal.blurb: Build one wall for yourself. Your garage, your shed, your spare room.

commercial.name: Commercial, single build
commercial.blurb: Build one wall for one customer or one gym. The installation is named on the licence.

contact.heading: Building more than one?
contact.body: Ten-build packs and OEM terms are a conversation, not a checkout button. Tell us what you are building and we will come back with a price.
contact.subject: Build plans: multi-build licence

configurator.heading: Configure your wall
configurator.intro: Everything below changes what gets cut. Pick the numbers your shop works to.

board.label: Board
board.help: Kilter Homewall is the only board on sale today.

size.label: Wall size
size.help: The Kilter size you are building. It sets the hold grid and the wall dimensions.

kicker.label: Kicker
kicker.help: The angled panel at the bottom. Only the 12 ft walls have one.

options.heading: Manufacturing
options.help: Defaults are what we build to. Change them to match your shop.

sheetStock.label: Sheet size
sheetStock.help: The plywood your shop cuts from. A 3.6 m sheet lets a wall row be cut without a seam.

panelThicknessMm.label: Panel thickness
panelThicknessMm.help: 18 mm is standard. Thinner flexes, thicker is heavier to hang.

tnutHoleDiameterMm.label: T-nut hole
tnutHoleDiameterMm.help: Match the barrel on the T-nuts you bought. 12.5 mm suits the common M10.

ledHoleDiameterMm.label: LED hole
ledHoleDiameterMm.help: Match the LED kit you are running behind the wall.

kickerMatClearanceMm.label: Kicker clearance above the mat
kickerMatClearanceMm.help: How much space the kicker leaves above your mat.

studClearanceOffsetMm.label: Stud clearance
studClearanceOffsetMm.help: Shifts the hold grid sideways so no hole lands on a stud.

gridPitchMm.label: Hold spacing
gridPitchMm.help: 100 mm for a metric build, 101.6 mm if you want exactly 4 inches.

dxfFlavour.label: DXF format
dxfFlavour.help: R12 writes real circles, which more machine controllers read as drill points.

paper.label: Printed sheets
paper.help: The paper size the check prints come on.

engraveHoldIds.label: Engrave hold numbers
engraveHoldIds.help: Routes the Kilter hold number next to every T-nut.

engraveAngleTicks.label: Engrave set-screw angles
engraveAngleTicks.help: Routes a tick showing which way each set screw points.

engrave.heading: Engraving
engrave.help: Both are off by default. They only make sense on a Kilter wall, and the pack cuts fine without them.
engrave.note: Hold numbers and set-screw angles come from Kilter's own layout. We are still getting legal advice on shipping them, so leave them off if you would rather not wait for that answer.

artwork.heading: Custom text and logos
artwork.help: Route your own words into a panel, or upload a logo. Up to {{count}} items, and we check every one against the hole grid before you buy.
artwork.full: That is all {{count}} labels this pack can carry.
artwork.textHelp: Up to {{max}} characters. Cut as outlines, so it looks the same on any machine.

engrave.label: Engrave
engrave.help: Scores the surface. Shallow, and the panel keeps all its strength.

pocket.label: Pocket
pocket.help: Clears the letters to a depth, so they catch the light.

cut_through.label: Cut through
cut_through.help: Goes all the way through. Needs more room around the holes, and takes material out of the panel.

artwork.panelHelp: Which sheet it gets routed into.
artwork.fits: Fits. Clear of every hole and seam.
artwork.doesNotFit: That will not cut where it is. Move it and we will re-check.
artwork.signInToCheck: Sign in and we will check your labels against the hole grid.
artwork.blocksCheckout: Move your labels somewhere they fit before you buy.

issues.text: Type what this label should say.
issues.width: Width has to be between {{min}} and {{max}} mm.
issues.rotation: Rotation has to be between -180° and 180°.

collisions.off_panel: This one runs off the panel, or sits too close to its edge.
collisions.keepout: This one lands on a T-nut or LED hole.
collisions.cut_through_keepout: A cut-through needs more room around the holes than this one has.
collisions.crosses_seam: This one spans two panels, so it would be cut in half.
collisions.unknown: This one cannot be routed where it is.

upload.help: SVG, up to 5 MB. Convert strokes to outlines first — we cut the path itself, not around it.
upload.signIn: Sign in to upload a logo.

errors.tooLarge: That file is too big. 5 MB is the most we can take.
errors.noFile: No file came through. Pick your logo again and upload it.
errors.unsupportedType: We could not read that as a drawing. Export it again as a plain SVG.
errors.unsafeDrawing: That drawing does something we will not cut — a script, a linked font, an outside image. Export it again as a plain SVG.
errors.noViewBox: That drawing has no viewBox, so there is nothing to size it against. Export it again from your editor.
errors.tooComplex: That drawing has more detail than a router can follow. Simplify the paths and try again.
errors.imageTooSmall: That image is too small to trace. 64 pixels a side is the minimum.
errors.imageTooLarge: That image is too big to trace. 4096 pixels a side is the maximum.
errors.unreadableImage: We could not open that image. Export it again as a PNG.
errors.rateLimited: That is a lot of uploads. Give it a few minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: Uploads are not working right now. Nothing was charged. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: That upload did not go through. Try again.

editor.canvasLabel: Your wall. Drag the label where you want it.
editor.keyboardHelp: Arrows move it 10 mm, hold shift for 1 mm. [ and ] turn it 5°. Plus and minus change the width.
editor.holesUnavailable: Sign in to see the hole grid on your wall.
editor.offPanel: It hangs off the panel, or sits too close to the edge.
editor.holesInTheWay_one: It lands on {{count}} hole. Move it clear.
editor.holesInTheWay_other: It lands on {{count}} holes. Move it clear.
editor.crossesSeam: It runs across a seam, so it would be cut in half.
editor.clear: Clear of every hole and seam on this panel.

licensee.heading: Who the licence names
licensee.help: This goes on every file in the pack, so a leaked copy traces back to the licence.
licensee.name: Name on the licence
licensee.emailHelp: Where the pack lands when it is ready.
licensee.siteHelp: The one installation this commercial licence covers.
licensee.required: Fill this in before you buy.

cta.signInBody: Your licence needs an account to live on. We will bring you straight back to your configuration.

errors.CNC_INVALID_CONFIG: That combination will not cut. Change something above and we will re-check it.
errors.CNC_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: The plan generator is not answering right now. Nothing was charged. Try again in a minute.
errors.CNC_CHECKOUT_UNAVAILABLE: Payments are not available right now. Nothing was charged. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: That did not go through. Nothing was charged.

flow.heading: How it works
flow.intro: Previews are free. Nothing is charged until you finalise.

configure.title: Configure your wall
configure.body: Pick the size, the sheets your shop cuts from, the hole diameters, and anything you want routed into a panel.

preview.title: Get a free preview
preview.body: We lay out every sheet and send back watermarked drawings. Change something and preview again, as often as you like.

finalise.title: Finalise and build
finalise.body: Name the licence, pay, and the cut-ready DXF files and print sheets land in your account.
